title: partnerships-marketplace-daily-notes-ava
content:
Daily scratchpad - partnerships / marketplace (Ava)

2026-02-24
Quick notes after sync with AcmeAI (partner) / internal follow-ups. Mostly TODOs and reminders for the integration checklist.

Meeting gist:
- Partner seeking fast time-to-market for marketplace listing + hosted integration.
- Wants a demo with sample billing estimates and an end-to-end flow (account connect -> API call -> usage billing).
- Raised questions about rate limits, per-customer quotas, and SSO for marketplace-managed installs.

High-priority next steps (short):
- Send follow-up email with proposed timeline + staging access (by EOD 2/25). owner: Ava
- Share initial billing model draft (hosted api per-token + marketplace take) with Finance. owner: Samir, due 3/01
- Provide sandbox API key and sample cURL + SDK snippet. owner: Eng-sdks (Chris), target 2/27
- Confirm SSO options for marketplace installs (SAML / OAuth). owner: Jordan P., target 3/03

Integration checklist (working):
- [ ] API access
  - create sandbox API key (scoped) -> Chris
  - document rate limits & retry guidelines -> Eng/Docs
- [ ] Webhook setup
  - events: install.created, billing.usage, install.revoked -> need schema
  - signed payloads? ask security (HMAC) -> Security team
- [ ] Billing & metering
  - define unit (tokens vs calls) for marketplace listing -> Product/Finance
  - show example invoice in demo -> Samir
- [ ] Entitlements & quota
  - per-customer quotas + soft limits -> Eng infra
  - automatic throttling behavior documented
- [ ] SSO / Identity
  - SAML vs OAuth flows for marketplace-managed orgs -> Legal/regulatory check for data sharing
- [ ] Data residency & logs
  - confirm hosted logs retention policy -> SRE/ops
- [ ] Security review
  - PCI/PII considerations? minimal for LLMs but check sample data handling -> Security

Staging test plan (short):
- Provision partner org in staging -> create 2 test users (install flow).
- Run smoke tests: generate text, streaming responses, error handling, webhook delivery.
- Load test: simulate 100 req/s for 30s on typical prompts (watch latency + mem usage).
- Validate billing events emitted and correct meter calculation for embeddings + text generation.

Open questions / risks:
- Rate-limit mismatch: partner wants burst of ~500 r/s for short windows — need dedicated routing or burst capacity (cost implications).
- Marketplace legal contract: who is primary data controller for logs? escalate to Legal.
- Pricing expectations: partner expects < $0.02/1k tokens effective — will need quantization + batching suggestions from Optimize team.

Notes to self / quick reminders:
- Draft the follow-up email template: timeline + bullet list of what they need to do to test. keep short.
- Add demo script to shared deck: 5-min install, 3-min usage walkthrough, 2-min billing explanation.
- Link GH PR once SDK snippet ready and include in email.

Links / refs:
- GH PR (sdk snippets): https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-integration/pull/78
- Jira epic: JIRA-MKT-342
- Confluence ops notes: confluence:marketplace-integration-ops

Small todo (today):
- Email partner with staging URL + ask preferred SSO type (Ava)
- Ping Chris about sandbox key (Slack: @chris-eng)
- Add billing examples to Google Sheet for Finance review (Samir)

Random brainstorm (raw):
- Could offer a "starter pack" marketplace plan: 3-month discounted credits + 1-click SSO + pre-built webhook handler -> faster onboarding.
- Consider a marketplace-specific rate-limit preset so partners don't need custom infra immediately.

End of notes.

(Informal - will extract action items into Jira after 2/25 follow-up)
